paragraphs: MOIA America is described on its homepage as more than a technology provider, offering autonomous vehicles, software and operations support as the tools to bring autonomous mobility to life. The about page states that the integrated platform combines autonomous vehicle technology, Mobility-as-a-Service (MaaS) software, and operational services. The MOIA Turnkey Solution is presented as a combination of purpose-built vehicles, software, and operational expertise aimed at autonomous, on-demand technology.

Mobility options named on the homepage include ridepooling and line services, tied to helping cities become more livable for everyone. Those autonomous mobility services are presented as integrating with transportation networks, expanding coverage, improving accessibility, and providing efficient, on-demand transportation.

MOIA America is based in Belmont, California, and conducts on-road testing in multiple markets, including Los Angeles, Austin, and Orlando. Ongoing testing in simulations and real cities across the United States supports continued evaluation and refinement of the autonomous mobility platform.

quote.text: We believe mobility can create stronger, more connected communities.
